_comment: applyVersionFlag: how --version folds into the positional selector, producing the candidate spellings to resolve. A version-less selector yields both grammars' spellings (ladder '-' and canonical '@') under infer, and only the canonical one under --input-format=canonical. A selector that already pins @version must AGREE. See TESTING.md.

provenance.ref: the flag is optional; with it unset the selector must reach resolution untouched

mutation.description: no version is supplied, so no candidate may be synthesized

provenance.ref: the two grammars spell a version differently; unioning both is what makes --version work identically on either without the caller knowing which they wrote

mutation.description: a version is supplied on a version-less selector under the default format

provenance.ref: a canonical selector with a variant must still accept --version; only the '@' candidate will resolve, but offering both keeps one rule for all selectors

mutation.description: the selector carries a variant segment, so the ladder candidate is nonsense and the canonical one must carry the query

provenance.ref: --input-format=canonical promises exactly one grammar, so synthesizing a ladder candidate would contradict the promise

mutation.description: the strict canonical format is requested, which must suppress the ladder candidate

provenance.ref: a redundant but consistent --version is harmless and must not double-append a second version segment

mutation.description: --version repeats the version the selector already pins

provenance.ref: shell quoting can leave padding on either value; it must not reach the resolver as part of a name

mutation.description: both inputs are padded with spaces

provenance.ref: grok-build is a real family whose name contains a dash; composition must append rather than reinterpret the existing dash

mutation.description: the family name itself contains the ladder separator

provenance.ref: ruled: a canonical selector plus a disagreeing --version is an actionable error, never a silent precedence win for either

mutation.description: --version is set to a version different from the selector's @version
